title: Tensor Autograd with Matmul
signature: class Tensor: data, grad, __add__, __mul__, __matmul__, __radd__, __rmul__, __neg__, __sub__, __rsub__, relu(), sum(), mean(), backward()
hints: Reuse the scalar engine's structure: each op returns a new Tensor with its parents and a _backward closure. backward() walks a reverse topological order.
For C = A @ B with upstream gradient G: dA = G @ B.T and dB = A.T @ G. Check the shapes.
add and mul broadcast, so their gradients must be summed back down to each operand's shape (unbroadcast) before you accumulate.
sum() sends its gradient to every element unchanged. mean() sends grad / N, where N is the number of elements.
